Kit summary

Full BloomBasicExclusive Lv.1
Deals Direct DMG by 15% of Kallana's Max HP to a single enemy and reduces the target's Turn Meter by 18%.
Floral Staff Lv.1The following effects can be triggered once respectively during each wave: 1. After casting Flower of Hope proactively, casts Fluttering Petals 1 more time. 2. After casting Fluttering Petals proactively, casts Flower of Hope 1 more time. 3. When Kallana's turn ends, she casts Full Bloom to pursue and attack the enemy who has dealt the highest DMG currently.
Flower of HopeActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Grants all allies [Flower Bud] for 3 turns (reduces Direct DMG taken by 40%; this effect is considered as [Consolidation] and cannot be stacked with [Consolidation]). Afterward, restores all allies' HP by 14% of Kallana's Max HP and cleanses all DoT debuffs from them.
Floral Staff Lv.1The following effects can be triggered once respectively during each wave: 1. After casting Flower of Hope proactively, casts Fluttering Petals 1 more time. 2. After casting Fluttering Petals proactively, casts Flower of Hope 1 more time. 3. When Kallana's turn ends, she casts Full Bloom to pursue and attack the enemy who has dealt the highest DMG currently.
Floral Staff Lv.2Flower of Hope also increases all allies' Turn Meters by 15% and cleanses all Control effects from them. Before Fluttering Petals deals DMG, deducts 70% of the current Shield value of all [Shield] owned by enemies first (caps at 100% of Kallana's Max HP). After anyone's turn starts, when an ally steals attributes from an enemy, increases Kallana's Turn Meter by 10%; this effect can only be triggered once in any turn.
Waltz of FlowersPassiveExclusive Lv.3
When entering a battle, if self has more than 1000 points of initial SPD, for every 1 point exceeding 1000, self gains 80 extra point(s) of HP, up to 160000 points can be obtained. When self takes DMG from enemies' proactively cast basic attacks or skills, other allies will counterattack the caster once. For every 1 ally with the [Poison] tag deployed, increases all allies' [Poison] DMG dealt by 15%.
Floral Staff Lv.3For every 1 ally with the [Attribute Steal] tag deployed, reduces all allies' Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG taken by 15%. When 5 allies with the [Attribute Steal] tag are deployed, Kallana and the ally with the highest initial ATK gain [Flower Protection] (blocks all Control effects). At the beginning of each wave, increases Kallana's Turn Meter by 30%.
Fluttering PetalsActiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
Deals [Poison] DMG by 28% of Kallana's Max HP to all enemies, with a 100% chance to inflict [Deep Poisoning II] for 2 turns. Afterward, steals 8% SPD from non-boss enemies (caps at 8% of initial SPD and each target can be stolen 2 times) and gains 20% of the stolen SPD for 2 turns.
